method: 2 fps frame review of the tone-mapped master (239 frames)

beats.visible: Start in a long corridor washed in hot magenta and violet LED light. White walls, square white pillars on the right, polished stone floor glowing red. A cluster of guests far ahead.
Walking past the first pillar; a group stands near the far end where blue light leaks in.
Approaching the crowd; people in dark clothes chat in the magenta haze.
A guest in black walks toward and past the camera on the right; a woman with a phone passes left.
Doorway edge on the left; the corridor opens up. Far ahead a row of black portrait screens on stands lines the left wall.
Pillars repeat on the right; the screen row grows larger on the left.
LED camera screens come into view on the left: tall portrait displays on black stands, each with a small webcam on top.
Passing the first screen: an ornate gilded digital frame shows a live camera view of the room.
Screens show gold oval and arched frames; small 'come closer' text at top. Backpacks and cables at the stands' feet.
Last screens of the row slide by on the left; guests ahead, blue light at the far windows.
A final portrait screen with an oval gilded frame passes close on the left.
Corridor continues; a pillar on the right, guests walking toward us.
A guest with a tote bag crosses left to right in front of the camera.
Following a woman with a backpack; a crowd gathers near the windows at the end.
Guests walk past; one wears a shirt with a big red heart.
A blue 'NOUSCON' banner hangs on the left wall; velvet-rope stanchions ahead.
Man in a suit with a tote walks toward us past the NOUSCON banner.
Magenta gives way to cooler light: a curved white railing walkway with pink stanchions overlooks a glass-walled atrium.
Walking the curve along the white railing; pink rope stanchions on the right, windows full of guests beyond.
The light turns neutral white: a bright curved gallery with a white balustrade and a view down into the atrium.
Rounding the curve; guests come toward us on the white walkway; violet light grows ahead.
The walkway opens into a big blue-violet hall full of people.
Following the person with the striped backpack into the crowd; a white rail on the right.
Crowd in a violet hall: a woman in a white cap, groups chatting, lounge furniture by the windows.
Passing close to guests; a group in plaid and patterned shirts stands to the right.
Crowd near a wall on the left where a merch table glows; someone crouches over bags.
Coffered white ceiling with violet spots; guests in baseball jerseys.
A large room opens: on the right wall a big glowing projection screen; windows at the far end.
Projector screens on the right: a wall-sized projection of glyphs and icons, two people standing in front of it.
White display plinths in the middle of the room; lounge seating and windows ahead under blue light.
Deep blue room: people in long coats on the left, white plinths with objects, low lounge seating by the windows.
Panning right across the windows; dark night outside, blue spotlights on the ceiling.
Turning left into a darker blue hall: groups standing, a mezzanine above with blue light.
Under a big white column; a man in a hat walks toward us looking at his phone.
Passing the column; curtains on the right, a crowd under deep blue light.
A banner with a large face graphic on the left; two women walk toward us.
Two women walk toward the camera; on the right, people crowd around a big screen in front of white curtains (the Space Screen).
Crowd around the Space Screen area; people in jerseys and plaid.
Stairs appear on the left leading up; white columns; groups chatting.
Passing a column; guests in white tees walk by; an atrium opens ahead.
A double-height atrium: black leather cube seats and low tables, a balcony above lit blue with guests along the rail.
Walking past black leather cubes and a white side table with flowers; people sitting and talking.
A man sits on a leather cube in the foreground; guests stand by the far windows.
Leaving the atrium; a man in a teal sweater and a woman chat right in front of us.
A warmer white gallery: guests walking, display tables along the left wall.
Following a person in a long dark coat; artwork panels glow on the left wall.
White gallery with soft amber light at the far end; low tables with folded shirts on the left.
A man in a suit with a tote bag walks toward us; a warm-lit room with windows ahead.
Entering a quieter white room with tall windows; plinths in the distance.
CPU terminals: a row of white plinths along the windows, each with a monitor and a closed laptop; guests reading the screens.
Closer to the terminals; a couple embraces near the plinths; warm floor uplight.
A circular camera on the wall; guests at the terminal plinths; teal floor light.
Turning left into a bright white room with warm floor lighting and big windows.
Guests dance and chat in the white room; a dark doorway appears on the left.
A man in a white sweater stands in a black doorway.
Stepping through the black doorway into darkness.
Almost total darkness: a faint red glow on the left and a dotted green floor line.
In the dark: a teal glowing orb floats ahead, small points of light, a thin red light bar.
Still dark: a red-lit opening appears on the right.
Stepping out of the dark into a room flooded with red light.
Red room: guests walking, a white sign and screens by the windows, red pools of light on the floor.
Red room wide view: windows, guests in the distance, a small cyan screen glowing on the left.

chapters.title: The Magenta Mile
chapters.blurb: A corridor drowning in magenta light, white pillars, the first guests.

chapters.title: Come Closer
chapters.blurb: A row of portrait screens with webcams and gilded digital frames.

chapters.title: NOUSCON Corridor
chapters.blurb: The crowd thickens under the blue NOUSCON banner.

chapters.title: The White Curve
chapters.blurb: A curved white balcony walk with pink stanchions over the atrium.

chapters.title: Violet Hall
chapters.blurb: The main crowd, merch and a hall glowing violet.

chapters.title: Projection Room
chapters.blurb: Wall-sized projections, white plinths and night windows.

chapters.title: Deep Blue
chapters.blurb: Columns, curtains and the Space Screen under deep blue light.

chapters.title: The Atrium
chapters.blurb: A double-height lounge of black leather cubes under the balcony.

chapters.title: The Gallery
chapters.blurb: Warm white galleries, wall-mounted screens and quieter corners.

chapters.title: Terminal Row
chapters.blurb: White plinths, monitors and laptops by the windows.

chapters.title: Into the Dark
chapters.blurb: A black doorway, a floating teal orb, then a room flooded red. (Outro: too dark to track.)
